stepSecurity.statement: Independent technical report identifies three @joyfill/components 2773 beta versions as malicious.

socket.statement: Independent report identifies @joyfill/components@4.0.0-rc24-2773-beta.4 and explicitly links the package to the ongoing PolinRider supply-chain attack.

registryBoundary.reason: Registry access is not permitted because the documented PolinRider relation fails the prior genuinely-separate-family gate for this autonomous screen.

strictExclusionReason.consequence: Do not add @joyfill/components as a new independent primary-ledger family or future validation unit in this screen.

prohibitedInterpretations: This exclusion does not dispute the independently reported malicious release or establish that it is benign, safe, unchanged, or a non-event.
The documented PolinRider relation does not establish campaign completeness, a complete related-package set, a current publisher state, or a statistical-independence claim.

No registry response, package payload, archive, source extraction, installation, historical-install trace, reach value, blast-radius value, control, score, model, rank, interval, calibration result, or predictive metric is created.
